title: Covenant of Artorias
snippet:
Covenant of Artorias -  Dark Souls - ring - general_information 
 general_information : Covenant of Artorias allows the player to reach the Abyss. As such, it is necessary in order to reach the Four Kings boss battle. Without wearing the ring, it is impossible to survive the fall into the Abyss. Taking off the ring during the fight with the Four Kings will cause the player to be devoured by the Abyss. Other than this, the ring has no other purpose.

The Covenant of Artorias is one of the very few rings that do not carry over to NG+; players are required to kill Great Grey Wolf Sif every playthrough to obtain the ring and beat the game. This ring, when dropped, will end up in the chest behind Kingseeker Frampt after the player has quit and reloaded the game. However, in the remaster, it will automatically be in the player’s inventory.

title: Set of Artorias
snippet:
Set of Artorias -  Dark Souls - armor - characteristics 
 characteristics : The Set of Artorias is a very balanced medium armor set; most of its resistances are fairly close, with the exception of its higher resistance to fire damage and curse, as well as comparably low strike defense. Although it is one of the lighter medium armor sets, it has unremarkable poise, making it rather ineffective for taking many physical hits without the Wolf Ring, as the overall average defense and low poise could prove deadly if one gets frequently stunned. Despite all of this, the set proves to be a very useful set for those who prefer balance over raw physical defense.

title: Knight Artorias
snippet: A nation of humans freed from the shackles of the Darksign, in possession of an army empowered by their boundless Dark Soul, represented an unparalleled threat to the gods of Anor Londo, who branded the Darkwraiths diabolical enemies of man and of every living thing. Artorias, as one of the Four Knights of Gwyn, was sent to fight the dark soldiers of New Londo, being granted a Silver Pendant to deflect the Dark of the Abyss he would face. However this did not prove sufficient to cross into the Abyss of the Four Kings, and Artorias was forced to forge a covenant with the "beasts of the Abyss", obtaining a ring that would allow him to cross the Abyss, but also cursed his sword in the process. Artorias thus became known as the "Abysswalker" and hunted the Darkwraiths, but failed to eliminate the Four Kings and close the Abyss of New Londo. snippet:

 artorias_of_the_abyss : Alvina can be encountered briefly during the events of the *Artorias of the Abyss* DLC, in the Chasm of the Abyss. She cannot be interacted with, in the traditional sense, and has no dialogue.

She is found after falling through an illusory floor, and leads the player to an injured but protected Sif. Here the Chosen Undead may choose to secure the white wolf by clearing the area of humanity phantoms, receiving the Cleansing Greatshield as a gift.

Elizabeth pledges to tell future generations that Artorias defeated Manus and halted the Abyss, appearing to confirm that at least part of Artorias' legend was indeed a fabrication, though he was nevertheless a brave and extremely powerful knight.

title: Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed)
snippet:
Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed) -  Dark Souls - weapon - characteristics 
 characteristics : The Cursed variant of the Greatsword of Artorias has the Curse effect, which allows it to hit the Ghosts and block their attacks when in New Londo Ruins. This variant shares the same moveset as the true version, Greatsword of Artorias.

When ascending the weapon, it will only be displayed as "Greatsword of Artorias", it will not say "cursed". To be certain of which sword is already created and which is being created, look at the stats which are unique. Despite having Intelligence and Faith scaling values present, the weapon does not receive any damage bonus from them. To wield the sword effectively however, users must meet both requirements. Requiring 24/18/18/18 in stats means most builds will not likely be able to wield it effectively, since at least one of the four is usually not invested in. In particular, few builds tend to invest 18 in both Intelligence and Faith.

title: Abyss
snippet: Knight Artorias famously traversed New Londo's Abyss and hunted the Darkwraiths therein. He was protected by the power of a magical ring, which he gained after making a covenant with the beasts there. The ring prevented him from being swallowed by the void, but it led to his sword becoming cursed. In recognition of his actions, he was awarded one of Anor Londo's treasures, a Silver Pendant that allowed him to repel Dark sorceries; eventually he traveled to Oolacile to combat the threat of Manus, the lord of the Abyss. He ultimately failed in his mission he was overtaken by the dark, leaving behind his companion Sif.

title: Large Soul of a Crestfallen Knight
snippet:

 availability : A total of six can be found in each playthrough. Three are found in the base game, one in *Ashes of Ariandel* and two in *The Ringed City*:

Grand Archives

 availability : Starting equipment for the Sorcerer class.
Undead Burg.

title: Black Separation Crystal
snippet:
Black Separation Crystal -  Dark Souls - item - availability 
 availability : Granted to the player at the beginning of the game.

title: Darkwraith (covenant)
snippet:
Darkwraith (covenant) -  Dark Souls - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Accessing the Darkwraith covenant requires a few more steps than the others, as one must be able to speak with Kaathe. In order to access Kaathe, the Covenant of Artorias ring is required (obtained from killing the Great Grey Wolf Sif), as well as the Key to the Seal (obtained from Ingward) and defeating the Four Kings.

After defeating the Four Kings, Kaathe should appear if the player has not placed the Lordvessel for Frampt. Answering "Yes" to his question will make him transport the player to the Firelink Altar. Speaking to him again in the Abyss, after this event, will allow the player to join the Darkwraiths.

title: Abyss
snippet:
Abyss -  Dark Souls - location - trivia 
 trivia : Due to what was observed from Artorias, the phrase "falling into the Abyss" does not actually constitute entering it, but rather the near infinite and unconscious darkness of it seeking out lifeforms.
**This likely means that Wolnir was very much alive when he fell, which explains how he was able to teach grave wardens his pyromancy, though what exactly it really was that actually caused his death is uncertain.

title: Bell Keepers
snippet:
Bell Keepers -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : To join the Bell Keepers, the player must speak to the Bell Keeper of Alken at the entrance of Belfry Luna or Belfry Sol. Exhausting his dialogue will allow the player to join the covenant and accepting will have them recieve the Bell Keeper's Seal.

title: Silver Pendant
snippet:
Silver Pendant -  Dark Souls - item - description 
 description : Silver Pendant engraved with the crest of Artorias.

One of the ancient treasures of Anor Londo. Presented to Artorias for facing the Abyss.

Effectively deflects the Dark of the Abyss, especially in its magic forms.

title: Brass Set
snippet:
Brass Set -  Dark Souls - armor - plot 
 plot : Worn by the Darkmoon Knightess. She does not need to be killed in order to receive the armor set. Due to the circumstances of which the armor is obtained however, she will be hostile and the player will lose access to her services regardless.

title: Forest Hunter Sorcerer
snippet:
Forest Hunter Sorcerer -  Dark Souls - enemy - location 
 location : Located beyond the sealed door requiring the Crest of Artorias in Darkroot Garden.

title: Guardian Tail
snippet:
Guardian Tail -  Dark Souls - weapon - availability 
 availability : The Guardian Tail is only available in the Artorias of the Abyss DLC. It is obtained by cutting the tail off the Sanctuary Guardian boss guarding the Oolacile Sanctuary, or the two Lesser Sanctuary Guardians that spawn in its place after the defeat of Artorias the Abysswalker.

title: Illusory Wall
snippet:
Illusory Wall -  Dark Souls - mechanic - darkroot_garden 
 darkroot_garden : Immediately to the left of the sealed door opened by the Crest of Artorias is an illusory wall leading to a bonfire.

title: Hydra
snippet: The Darkroot Basin Hydra can also be approached from the opposite direction, taking the reverse shortcut from Darkroot Garden via the Crest of Artorias door. From this direction, the heads can be eliminated by shooting it with arrows, with the exception of one, drastically reducing the threat of its water projectiles.

title: New Game Plus
snippet:
New Game Plus -  Dark Souls - mechanic - items_lost 
 items_lost : The Orange Charred Ring.
The Covenant of Artorias.
All Keys and items that appear under Keys in-game, including Embers, the Rite of Kindling, Weapon Smithbox, Armor Smithbox, Repairbox, the Lordvessel and the Crest of Artorias.

Exceptions are the Master Key and the Bottomless Box, which are not lost.

If the player is human before entering New Game+, they lose their human status and will have to reverse hollowing at a bonfire.

title: Forest Hunter
snippet:
Forest Hunter -  Dark Souls - mechanic - requirements 
 requirements : The player must not have attacked Alvina.

In order to open the door leading to Alvina, players must obtain the Crest of Artorias. It is sold by Andre of Astora in Undead Parish. It is also possible to reach the covenant without opening the door, but the alternative route takes significantly more time to traverse and has far more enemies in the way.

title: Oolacile
snippet:
Oolacile -  Dark Souls - location - artorias_of_the_abyss 
 artorias_of_the_abyss : In *Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition* or *Artorias of the Abyss* DLC, the Chosen Undead passes through part of Oolacile after traveling into the past; however, despite it taking place centuries before the rest of the game, the Oolacile Township is still fraught with hopelessness. The township has become filled with enemies (specifically Bloatheads, Bloathead Sorcerers, and a Chained Prisoner) as the Abyss spreads, and is seemingly deserted.

One of the Four Knights of Gwyn, Artorias the Abysswalker, arrived in Oolacile to rescue Dusk of Oolacile from Manus, Father of the Abyss, but fell victim to the Abyss. By the time the Chosen Undead found him, Artorias was hostile and engaged them in combat. After the Chosen Undead defeated the brave knight, they finish what Artorias had started, continuing through Oolacile Township and onward, eventually defeating Manus and rescuing Dusk.

title: Dragon Remnants
snippet:
Dragon Remnants -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Talk to Magerold of Lanafir in Iron Keep, who will beg the player to be given the Petrified Egg if it's in their inventory. Giving him the treasure will allow players to enter the Dragon Remnants covenant, and they recieve an Ancient Dragon Seal and a Dragon Eye upon joining.

title: Ring of Displacement
snippet:
Ring of Displacement -  Dark Souls - ring - overview 
 overview : As the description states, the Ring of Displacement was intended to prevent the wearer from taking damage. However, in order to balance this, it had a fixed chance of breaking whilst it was worn. As it was removed from the game before release, it is unknown how the player would have obtained it normally.

title: Knight
snippet:
Knight -  Dark Souls - mechanic - lead 
 lead : The **Knight** is one of the Classes in *Dark Souls*.

The Knight is a tank class, and starts with the highest vitality value of all classes, as well as possessing the most robust equipment. This, however, comes at the price of slower movement - although the player can remove their helmet and gauntlets to allow them to medium roll at the start of the game without much defense loss. Due to their high Strength and Dexterity levels, Knights are able to easily equip most forms of weaponry, and their faith stat is high enough as to allow for Knights healing themselves with miracles.

The Knight automatically begins the game in the Way of White covenant, but unlike the Cleric class, does not have access to the early-game miracles (unless they are bought from Petrus of Thorolund).

title: Ring of Blind Ghosts
snippet:
Ring of Blind Ghosts -  Dark Souls - ring - overview 
 overview : As the description states, the Ring of Blind Ghosts was intended to prevent the wearer from being attacked by Ghosts and Banshees in the New Londo Ruins. It was also connected to Ingward, however, as it was removed from the game before release, it is unknown how the player would have obtained it normally.

title: Brotherhood of Blood
snippet:
Brotherhood of Blood -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Talk to Titchy Gren, located in the Undead Purgatory directly after the Executioner's Chariot boss fight. Reaching him before obtaining at least one Token of Spite will have him disregard the player, so be sure to find one if you wish to join the covenant. Upon meeting the requirements and confirming your desire of bathing in blood to Titchy Gren multiple times, players will be awarded the Crest of Blood.

title: Unknown Talisman
snippet:
Unknown Talisman -  Dark Souls - weapon - overview 
 overview : It was cut from the final release of the game, it is unknown how the player would have obtained it.

Due to its nature as cut content, the Unknown Talisman is simply a texture in the game files. This means that even if the player modified their save file to obtain it, it would have no stats.

title: Heirs of the Sun
snippet:
Heirs of the Sun -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : To join the Heirs of the Sun, the player must simply reach the Altar of Sunlight, located in Harvest Valley, and interact with it. Joining the covenant will have the recieve the Sun Seal.

title: Ashen Mist Heart
snippet:
Ashen Mist Heart -  Dark Souls II - shield - usage 
 usage : The locations for the memories are as follows:
Memory of Vammar: Located near the area that the player first meets Mild-Mannered Pate.
Memory of Orro: The giant tree is located directly after the area where the player fights The Pursuer as an actual boss.
Memory of Jeigh: Located next to The Place Unbeknownst bonfire, which requires the King's Ring to access. The Giant Lord is also fought here.
Dragon Memories: The crystal the player must examine is located directly underneath the dead ancient dragon in the area that the player fights The Duke's Dear Freja in Brightstone Cove Tseldora. In it, the player is transported to what is presumably the Unformed World, where they encounter the corpse of an Ancient Dragon and retrieve the Ancient Dragon Soul.
Memory of the King: Located in the Undead Crypt near King Vendrick's discarded clothing. *Crown of the Sunken King* is required to access it.

title: Locations (Dark Souls)
snippet:
Locations (Dark Souls) -  Dark Souls - location - artorias_of_the_abyss 
 artorias_of_the_abyss : The *Artorias of the Abyss* DLC takes place in the land of Oolacile, far back in the past. It includes the following locations:

title: Spears of the Church
snippet:
Spears of the Church -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : The player must simply equip the Spears of the Church covenant item.

title: Path of the Dragon
snippet:

 how_to_join : Talk to the Stone Dragon in Ash Lake. To access Ash Lake, travel from Blighttown to The Great Hollow and get to its very bottom; upon arriving there, follow the path along the beach to its end.

title: Illusory Ring of the Guilty
snippet:
Illusory Ring of the Guilty -  Dark Souls II - ring - general_information 
 general_information : Similarly to the Illusory Ring of a Conqueror and the Illusory Ring of the Exalted, the makes certain equipment invisible when worn. However, since it was removed from the final game, it is unknown what kind of equipment would have been affected, though it could have affected parts of a player's armor. Given its name, it is likely that the ring was intended to be obtained through the Brotherhood of Blood covenant.

title: Old Knight Set
snippet:
Old Knight Set -  Dark Souls II - armor - characteristics 
 characteristics : The Old Knight Set offers an immense amount of Poise for how early it can be obtained. While it has high physical defence, bleed resistance and poise, its elemental defenses and other status resistances are underwhelming.

Like all Old Knight gear, the durability of the set is extremely low, requiring one to take preventive measures to ensure the set does not break prior to reaching the next bonfire.

title: Illusory Ring of the Vengeful
snippet:

 general_information : Simiarly to the Illusory Ring of a Conqueror and the Illusory Ring of the Exalted, the makes certain equipment invisible when worn. title: Crest Shield
snippet:
Crest Shield -  Dark Souls - shield - characteristics 
 characteristics : What sets the Crest Shield apart from other medium shields is its massive 80% magic reduction. This makes the Crest Shield a powerful asset when facing magic-dealing enemies. When used in conjunction with miracles such as Great Magic Barrier, the player can become virtually immune to magic damage.

The Crest Shield has medium deflection and a normal parry speed.

title: Seek Guidance (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Seek Guidance (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - spell - effect 
 effect : Displays extra messages, as well as developer-set messages. Reveals the location of summon signs without the use of an Ember.

Does not allow the player to summon phantoms while unembered.

title: Blade of the Darkmoon (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Blade of the Darkmoon (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Obtained from Company Captain Yorshka upon talking to her and performing the "Darkmoon Loyalty" gesture at the Prison Tower in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

The tower can be reached via the rotating staircase that connects Irithyll to Anor Londo. An invisible pathway leading to the tower can be accessed from the lower level of the staircase when it is raised.

title: Darkdiver Grandahl
snippet:
Darkdiver Grandahl -  Dark Souls II - character - plot 
 plot : After finding all three shrines, Grandahl will extend the player an invitation into the Pilgrims of Dark covenant. Through each of these shrines the player may access a different part of the Dark Chasm. The player's first journey into the Dark Chasm will be free; however, should the player die, future journeys will require the sacrifice of a Human Effigy. Grandahl can be found in whichever shrine the player chooses to visit.

Completion of the Dark Chasm will allow the player to talk to Grandahl again, and he will give the player a Dragon Chime for doing so. After defeating the Darklurker, Grandahl will give the player the Xanthous Set.

title: Bonfire (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Bonfire (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - mechanic - irithyll_of_the_boreal_valley 
 irithyll_of_the_boreal_valley : ***Irithyll of the Boreal Valley**
:From the High Lord Wolnir bonfire, climb up the sets of stairs afterward to exit the catacombs and reach a cliffside overlooking the city, where the bonfire is found.

***Central Irithyll**
:From the Irithyll of the Boreal Valley bonfire, head straight across the bridge (a Sulyvahn's Beast will attack from behind). A magical barrier on the other side will prevent access inside the city. Having gained possession of the Small Doll will allow its owner to cross the barrier unharmed. This special item can be obtained by defeating the Deacons of the Deep in the Cathedral of the Deep.

title: Hawkwood's Shield
snippet:
Hawkwood's Shield -  Dark Souls III - weapon - description 
 description : Shield that belonged to Hawkwood, a deserter from the Undead Legion.

The unique swordsmanship of the Watchers does not normally allow for the use of shields. The unique swordsmanship of the Watchers would not allow such a shield, and Hawkwood's very possession of it was telltale of his defeat.

Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.

title: Spirit Tree Crest Shield
snippet:
Spirit Tree Crest Shield -  Dark Souls III - weapon - notes 
 notes : The spirit tree crest is quite similar to the crest of the Ethereal Oak on the cape of the Millwood Knight Armor set.

title: Ancient Dragon Soul
snippet:
Ancient Dragon Soul -  Dark Souls II - item - locations 
 locations : It can be found in the Dragon Memories, which can only be accessed through The Duke's Dear Freja's boss room on the player's second visit. There will be a crystal at the back of Freja's cave; interact with it and the player will enter the memory. Interact with the dragon's head to obtain the soul.

To access the memory, the player must first be sure to have spoken to the Ancient Dragon on top of the Dragon Shrine and obtained the Ashen Mist Heart.

title: Great Chaos Fireball
snippet:
Great Chaos Fireball -  Dark Souls - spell - general_information 
 general_information : The player hurls a giant fireball, which does a large amount of damage on impact with a good area of effect, identical to Great Fireball. The fireball has a fire attack power of 3.0 times the Pyromancy Flame's magic adjust and the lava pool has a fire attack power of 2.0 times the Pyromancy Flame's magic adjust.

Contrary to what the name suggests, Great Chaos Fireball does not scale with the player's amount of humanity (like Chaos weapons do). It can only be improved by upgrading and ascending the Pyromancy Flame used to cast it.

title: Cromwell the Pardoner
snippet:
Cromwell the Pardoner -  Dark Souls II - character - character_information 
 character_information : Cromwell, as his title implies, can be visited so the players may have their sins forgiven. This will remove the current sin title the player has, but it does allow hostile NPCs that the player provoked to become friendly again (the Royal Soldiers found in the Giant's Memories are excluded from this), as well as removing the damage penalty on the Lost Sinner's Sword, and thus reverting it to the normal damage it dealt.

He also sells many useful items, such as useful miracles (such as Great Heal and Perseverance) and the statusbite rings, which can greatly aid the player along the way.

He dons the Judgment Set, similarly to how Oswald of Carim donned the Black Set, and wields a Great Scythe.

title: Petrus of Thorolund
snippet:
After the Capra Demon in the lower Undead Burg is defeated, Petrus is joined by Reah of Thorolund and two companions from the Thorolund Order (named Vince and Nico) in the Firelink Shrine. They are on a secret mission and will not talk much about what is going on. Once the game has been reloaded or the player leaves Firelink Shrine, the visitors will be gone and Petrus will not talk much about what happened.

If the player talks to Lautrec of Carim he will offer information to the player for souls based upon level. He tells the player about how the lady and two companions went down to The Catacombs and got attacked, while Petrus escaped and left the others behind. If the player talks to Petrus after this, he will tell his side of the story and about how the lady is left alone and her companions have been turned to hollow.

Talking to Oswald of Carim will result in some implications and accusations against Petrus, claiming that his soul is drenched in sin.

title: Great Feline
snippet:
Great Feline -  Dark Souls - enemy - strategy 
 strategy : Staying on the outskirts can allow the player to quickly retreat behind the trees, where the Felines will not venture.

Moving along the cliff beyond Alvina's structure (when approaching from the sealed door requiring the Crest of Artorias), will eventually take the player to a ledge overlooking the area containing the Great Felines. From here, it is possible to engage them with ranged attacks or magic. The felines will be unable to pursue the player when attacking from this location.

Alternatively, if coming from the bridge, the player will be able to see the three felines at a distance before they turn hostile. The player can freely snipe the two that are further back and they won't react. The one on the front, however, will undoubtedly climb down to attack if harmed. Using poison arrows is recommended. It only takes about three to five arrows to poison them and then the player may add to the damage by using cheaper arrows.

title: Dusk of Oolacile
snippet:
Dusk of Oolacile -  Dark Souls - character - plot 
 plot : Dusk is an optional character for the main game; when summoned via her summon sign in Darkroot Basin, she sells the player sorceries from Oolacile as a reward for rescuing her. These include: Hidden Body, Cast Light and Chameleon. Depending on the player's playstyle, it may be well worth the trouble of rescuing her.

While interacting with her is not obligatory for progressing the main storyline, she must be sought out in order to access the *Artorias of the Abyss* DLC.

title: Bow of Want
snippet:
Despite it not having the full power of the miracle it appears to fire off, it still inflicts sizable damage, especially when reinforced to +5, and the spear-like projectiles are also capable of appreciable poise damage, and because of the lightning damage it will spread lightning around in water and does significant damage and also can cause players to lose their poise.

The Bracing Knuckle Ring +2 is also a great complement to the bow, as it will allow the player to use the Bow of Want's special attack a total of 13 times, before it breaks on the 14th use. Without the ring, the player will only have 6 total shots, before it breaks on the 7th.

title: Sacred Flame
snippet:
Sacred Flame -  Dark Souls III - spell - how_to_obtain 
 how_to_obtain : In order to survive the trip inside the lava, there are many strategies that can be followed and even combined before venturing inside. The main idea is to slow down the loss of HP, allowing the player to heal up and advance a bit further, repeating the process as many times as necessary until they have successfully obtained the item.

title: Stone Greataxe
snippet:
Stone Greataxe -  Dark Souls - weapon - availability 
 availability : 2% drop from Stone Guardians in the Royal Wood. This can only be obtained in the Artorias of the Abyss DLC.

title: Rat King (covenant)
snippet:
Rat King (covenant) -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Talk to the Rat King, located in either the Grave of Saints or the Doors of Pharros, after their respective bosses. While a Rat Tail is required to join the king's covenant, it's unlikely that players won't have one when they meet him, especially since they are dropped by the bosses who need to be defeated in order to reach him in the first place. Upon accepting his offer, players will be awarded the Crest of the Rat.

title: Crest of Blood
snippet:
Crest of Blood -  Dark Souls II - ring - description 
 description : Ring of the Brotherhood of Blood covenant.

This ring is nothing special. Perhaps, in the end, an oath is but a window into the ambitions of the oath taker.

If you have taken this oath, then you know what you want. To be soaked in the blood of your kind.

title: Crown of the Old Iron King
snippet:
Crown of the Old Iron King -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - access 
 access : To access the content, defeat the Old Iron King in Iron Keep and proceed to the Primal Bonfire. Use the altar behind the bonfire to travel to the starting area. Upon loading, the Heavy Iron Key will be added to the player's inventory, which grants access to Brume Tower.

This changes in the *Scholar of the First Sin* edition of the game; the Heavy Iron Key can be found inside of the door opened by the Iron Key, near The Last Giant's boss room in the Forest of Fallen Giants.

title: Crown of the Sunken King
snippet:
Crown of the Sunken King -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - access 
 access : To access the content, defeat The Rotten in Black Gulch and proceed to the Primal Bonfire. Use the altar behind the bonfire to travel to the starting area. Upon loading, the Dragon Talon will be added to the player's inventory.

This changes in the *Scholar of the First Sin* edition of the game; the Dragon Talon can be found on a body behind the 'Forgotten Door' unlocked with the Forgotten Key, at the bottom of the well in Majula. This door grants access to Shulva, Sanctum City.

title: Warrior of Sunlight
snippet:
Warrior of Sunlight -  Dark Souls - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Once all requirements are met, the player may kneel in front of the broken statue on the balcony behind the Hellkite Dragon.

title: Four Knights of Gwyn
snippet:
Four Knights of Gwyn -  Dark Souls - character - artorias_the_abysswalker 
 artorias_the_abysswalker : Artorias had an unbreakable will of steel and his skill with greatswords was unmatched, making him a fierce opponent. Additionally, he was known as the first mortal to traverse the Abyss.

Although Artorias is only scarcely mentioned during the Chosen Undead's journey to the Kiln of the First Flame, he is one of the many obstacles the Chosen Undead encounters in Oolacile. Gravely injured and corrupted by the Abyss by the time he is encountered, Artorias still proves a formidable foe although the Chosen Undead eventually prevails. Hawkeye Gough will thank the player for setting Artorias free with honor.

title: Farron Coal
snippet:
Farron Coal -  Dark Souls III - item - availability 
 availability : Found in the Road of Sacrifices on what once was the eastern access to the keep. The area can be reached by following the eastern shore of the marsh, fighting a couple of Lycanthropes along the way. The coal can be found at the end of a blocked passageway, guarded by a Black Knight.

title: Crimson Set
snippet:
Crimson Set -  Dark Souls - armor - plot 
 plot : The set is worn by Ingward and the other two sealers of New Londo, Yulva and one of Lautrec of Carim's unnamed companions, although said companion does not wear the head piece. The Mask of the Sealer symbolizes the resolve of the sealers to keep the seal shut and to demonstrate their atonement for those sacrificed in the process of sealing what is now the New Londo Ruins. The set that the player finds likely once belonged to Yulva, as her sorcery, Remedy, is found with it.

title: Giant (Dark Souls II)
snippet:
Giant (Dark Souls II) -  Dark Souls II - enemy - giant_memories 
 giant_memories : Once the Ashen Mist Heart has been obtained, it can be used to interact with the corpses of three fallen Giants who fought in the war against Vendrick. The heart grants access to the memories of Jeigh, Orro and Vammar. In these memories, the player can witness various battles that took place between the Giants and Vendrick's army. According to Sweet Shalquoir, the Giants savour their memories of glory on the battlefield.

title: Crest of the Rat
snippet:

snippet:
Despite sharing a name with a Norse goddess, Sif's gender is unconfirmed, and is not directly stated in either the English or Japanese versions of the game.
**In translations for languages that have grammatical gender, the masculine form of "wolf" is often used when referring to Sif. In French, Sif is called *Le Grand Loup Gris*, using the masculine "loup" rather than the feminine "louve", In Spanish, Sif is called *El Gran Lobo Gris*, using the masculine "lobo" rather than the feminine "loba", In Russian, Sif is called *Великий Волк*, using the masculine "волк" rather than the feminine "волчица", In Italian, Sif is called *Il Grande Lupo Grigio*, using the masculine "lupo" rather than the feminine "lupa".
**In the strategy guide by FuturePress, Sif is referred using masculine pronouns.
Another possible naming influence is the Arabic *saif* or *sayf*, meaning "sword".

title: Great Grey Wolf Sif
snippet: If the Chosen Undead saves Sif in the Chasm of the Abyss before killing Sif in Darkroot Garden, a different cutscene will play before the fight; however this will prevent you from meeting Kaathe, because you need to place the Lordvessel and visit the Duke's Archives to access the DLC. In the cutscene, Sif will recognize the player as they approach and let out a whimper. The protagonist reaches out to pet the wolf, but Sif pulls away and howls mournfully before sadly picking up Artorias' greatsword. The fight will continue as normal after this point.

title: Great Grey Wolf Sif
snippet:
Using miracles, sorcery, or pyromancy to soften Sif up before moving in with melee attacks can also prove to be effective.
Using a summoned phantom as a decoy can make positioning oneself under Sif easier. In a party of two or more players only one should try to get under Sif, otherwise players may bump into each other when trying to dodge Sif's attacks.
Sif's attacks can be blocked, but most of them will cause a significant loss of stamina, even with a good shield. Learning Sif's attack patterns and avoiding them completely, either by dodging or simply walking out of the way, is highly recommended.

title: Great Grey Wolf Sif
snippet:
Great Grey Wolf Sif -  Dark Souls - boss - strategies 
 strategies : For melee fighters, getting underneath Sif is generally the best strategy, as it makes most attacks miss the player character completely. Care must still be taken to dodge, block or move out of the way of the slam attack, though. Locking on is not always a good idea when doing this, as it can make the camera spin and make it harder to control one's position. Two-handing is more effective, as it will make the fight shorter and reduce the number of slams that need to be dodged.
For ranged characters, players can simply target-lock Sif and kite Sif backwards around the edge of the arena. Staying as far as possible away from Sif will cause most, if not all, of Sif's attacks to miss.
Using miracles, sorcery, or pyromancy to soften Sif up before moving in with melee attacks can also prove to be effective.

snippet: Before the player enters through the fog gate, there is a broken piece of bridge to the left that can be jumped onto. This is most easily accomplished by unequipping all gear beforehand. After reaching the bridge there is another pile of rock resting at the top that can easily be reached through jumping. When at the top, Sif will be visible. Sif will be unable to reach the player, but the player will be able to damage Sif with arrows or other ranged attacks.

title: Great Grey Wolf Sif
snippet:
Great Grey Wolf Sif -  Dark Souls - boss - trivia 
 trivia : In Norse mythology, Sif is the golden-haired wife of the god Thor.
** The goddess Sif's name in Old Norse is pronounced /siːf/, "seef", though it is often anglicized to /sɪf/, "siff". It is also a female given name in modern day Iceland.
**The name "Sif" is believed to be a singular form derived from Old Norse *sifjar*, "connection by marriage". The modern English "sib", as in "sibling", comes from the same root, as does the German "Sippe", meaning "tribe" or, coloquially, "family".
** In *Advanced Dungeons & Dragons* sourcebook *Legends & Lore* (1984), the goddess Sif is depicted wielding a longsword and wearing white and silver. These traits are shared with the Dark Souls boss Sif.
Despite sharing a name with a Norse goddess, Sif's gender is unconfirmed, and is not directly stated in either the English or Japanese versions of the game.

Helm of Artorias -  Dark Souls - armor - characteristics 
 characteristics : One of the lightest head armors between the medium armor sets, however, also has lower defenses compared to most of them, except for its Fire, Poison, Bleed and Curse resistances, which are above average, with fire being one of the highest out of the medium armors.

The face visible beneath the shroud of the helm when human or hollow is not the player's face, but rather a pre-textured part of the helm. It is not affected by any aspect of the character creation, such as face type, skin color, or even sex.

title: Helm of Artorias
snippet:
Helm of Artorias -  Dark Souls - armor - description 
 description : Helm of Artorias the Abysswalker, one of Gwyn's four knights.

The death of the helm's owner can be surmised from the corrosive Dark of the Abyss, and the musty azure-blue tassel, once a symbol of pride and glory.
